name: ml-paper-studio
description: Evidence-first ML/AI paper writing from Chinese outlines and literature research to academic English and LaTeX/PDF.

interface.longDescription: A six-stage ML/AI writing workflow: verify venue requirements, derive a Chinese outline from research evidence, investigate prior work, draft and review in Chinese, revise in academic English, and prepare LaTeX/PDF. Helpers check structure and byte bindings; they do not certify scientific validity, peer review, or submission compliance. Python and a suitable TeX/PDF environment are needed for the relevant operations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ML Paper Studio to turn my research evidence into a Chinese outline and a defensible contribution statement.
